SASOL ANNOUNCES RESULTS OF THE INVITATION TO REPURCHASE OUTSTANDING
US$750 MILLION 4.5% GUARANTEED SENIOR UNSECURED CONVERTIBLE BONDS DUE
2027


Sasol Limited is pleased to announce the results of the invitation by Sasol Financing International
Limited, its indirect wholly owned subsidiary (the “Purchaser”), to repurchase for cash the
outstanding US$750 million 4.5% guaranteed senior unsecured convertible bonds due 2027 issued
by Sasol Financing USA LLC (the “Issuer”) (ISIN: XS2546248373) (the “2027 Convertible Bonds”)
(the “Invitation”).


The Invitation was announced by the Purchaser earlier today and is more fully described in an
invitation term sheet (the “Invitation Term Sheet”) prepared by the Purchaser in connection with the
Invitation and dated 17 November 2026. Capitalised terms used but not otherwise defined in this
announcement shall have the meanings given to them in the announcement dated 17 November
2026 announcing the Invitation (amongst other things).


As at the expiration deadline for the Invitation at 6.30 p.m. (SAST) on 17 November 2026, the
Purchaser had received valid offers to sell from Eligible Bondholders representing approximately
US$737.8 million in aggregate principal amount of the 2027 Convertible Bonds (representing
approximately 98.4 per cent. of the aggregate principal amount of the 2027 Convertible Bonds
originally issued). The Purchaser announces that it has decided to set the Final Acceptance
Amount at approximately US$737.8 million and, accordingly, the Purchaser will accept for
purchase all 2027 Convertible Bonds validly tendered for purchase pursuant to the Invitation in full,
with no pro rata scaling.


Eligible Bondholders whose 2027 Convertible Bonds are accepted for purchase in the Invitation will
receive the Repurchase Price, being US$215,000 per US$200,000 in principal amount of the 2027
Convertible Bonds, plus accrued interest to (but excluding) the Invitation Settlement Date (which,
on the basis of the expected Invitation Settlement Date, will amount to US$400 per US$200,000 in
principal amount of the 2027 Convertible Bonds).
Subject to the satisfaction or waiver of the Financing Condition and the satisfaction or waiver of the
Invitation Settlement Condition (each as defined in the Invitation Term Sheet), settlement of the
repurchases pursuant to the Invitation is expected to occur on or around 24 November 2026 (the
“Invitation Settlement Date”). The 2027 Convertible Bonds repurchased by the Purchaser through
the Invitation will be cancelled in accordance with their terms and conditions.


If the Financing Condition is satisfied or waived and the Invitation Settlement Condition is satisfied
or waived, then following the Invitation Settlement Date, approximately US$12.2 million in
aggregate principal amount of the 2027 Convertible Bonds is expected to remain outstanding.
Following the cancellation of the 2027 Convertible Bonds repurchased in the Invitation, as less
than 15 per cent. of the principal amount of 2027 Convertible Bonds originally issued will remain
outstanding, the Issuer intends to exercise the clean-up call and redeem the remaining outstanding
2027 Convertible Bonds, in whole but not in part, at their principal amount, together with accrued
but unpaid interest, in accordance with the terms and conditions of the 2027 Convertible Bonds.
BofA Securities and Mizuho acted as Joint Dealer Managers for the Invitation.

MANAGER OR SUCH AFFILIATE, AS THE CASE MAY BE, ON BEHALF OF THE PURCHASER

THIS ANNOUNCEMENT MUST BE READ IN CONJUNCTION WITH THE INVITATION TERM
